reviews.comment: She is the sweetest professor ever! I recommend going to class because it really helps with the exams. Fridays were asynchronous with short, easy quizzes. Exams are fair but require knowing theories since questions are scenario-based. Overall, a very positive class.

I love her so much! Professor Tang really wants her students to do well in her class and learn what she teaches. She uses examples that are interesting and make you want to pay attention. If you listen to her in class, honestly, that is all you need. Take her!!
Dr. Tang is actually a good lecturer; she is funny and engaging. There are three tests and 1 group project.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Super easy, fun class. The work isn't difficult if you just take the time to get it done. Attendance isn't technically mandatory, but she does 4 pop quizzes throughout the semester so see if people show up.

Dr. Tang is an amazing professor! She is so good at explaining theories in a way that makes sense. There are 3 tests and 1 major group project (it is really fun). Attendance isn't technically required, but there are pop quizzes that occur randomly, so go to class anyway. It also makes the tests easier. She's great at giving good feedback!
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I loved Dr Tang! She was a really good lecturer and included lots of pop culture references in her slides that helped explain the concepts. She was always quick to respond to emails and was very understanding when I was sick. She has pop quizzes for attendance so I recommend going. Tests are kind of difficult even when I would study. But take it!
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: There is a quiz due two days before class that is online with a YouTube video of her lecturing. Exams are easy to study for because all PowerPoints are online. Super easy and she's funny

I loved Dr.Tang! She is one of my favorite teachers at TAMU. She is kind and clear with instruction, makes her lectures fun and interesting. I always looked forward to coming to her class. Her tests are always very straightforward.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's very funny during her lectures but that's all it is, lectures. 6 pop quizzes throughout the semester so going to class is very recommended. I personally thought the tests were kinda tricky even after studying a lot but I heard she's a lot better than the other comm 305 guy professor. group project helped save my grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I honestly liked her as a professor, shes very funny and pretty good at lecturing. she's a little chaotic but in a good way LOL. 3 exams, 1 group project for the final, and pop quizzes thru the semester so go to class!! exams arent hard but I def had to study for them. i would recommend her class though.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Love Dr. Tang! She has great lectures and truly cares about the subject. There are random quizzes in class so show up, but her lectures are always interesting to listen to. Tests aren't too bad if you study, and there is one group project that isn't too much work. Definitely recommend her!
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Professor Tang is an amazing professor for COMM 305! She is so caring, funny, and genuinely wants us to learn. However, attendance is mandatory because she will do lots of pop quizzes at the beginning/ end of class. These quizzes are extremely easy, they are more just to see if you were listening and in attendance. If you get the chance, take her!

Professor Dr. Tang was great. She is so humorous and made coming to class fun. She does have previously recorded lectures which were a life saver if you were absent! Overall, I would take this class again and would love to have Dr. Tang as a professor again.
great professor, interesting content, cares for her students! taking her again

Loved her. You were able to buy the older version of the book to save money. Class was straightforward and I enjoyed her lectures. She is good about providing different examples and wanting to make sure we understand. She's very caring towards her students. I'd love to take her again! If you can take her, don't pass her up!

Comm 305 with tang has been one of the easiest classes I have taken at A&M. DONT BUY THE TEXTBOOK! I didn't open it once. Take notes in the lectures (info in addition to what she puts on the powerpoint slides) and you will have no choice but to get an A. Attendance wasn't mandatory and there is no lecture on fridays (only an online quiz)
I love her! she posts her lectures online so class is not mandatory. she is hilarious in her lectures and shows videos to help you understand the material

Loved Dr. Tang and loved the class. Lu Tang is a sweet lady and works with her students to ensure success. I was sick on one exam and she allowed me to make it up due to covid protocol. All exams are in-person and closed note except for the last one. She really does a great job explaining topics and giving concrete examples of them. Would take agai

This was one of my favorite professors this semester. She cares about making her lectures enjoyable and easy to listen to. She is interactive with the class and is just an overall great prof. Not much homework, just quizzes, a group project that is fun, and exams that are not cumulative.
Dr. Tang is amazing! The material is super easy to understand and she does her best to make class entertaining, especially over zoom.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Good prof. Her lectures were super boring in my opinion but Zoom lectures are never fun. Class is not hard just pay attention and you should pass. Nice lady.
Such a sweet prof! We had weekly quizzes that were easy as long as you listened to her online lectures (which were short), 2 tests (normally 3 though), and YouTube project.

This class is very easy. An A is super attainable! We had 2 tests (normally there would be 3), quizzes that were easy and a video project at the end of the semester. Lu Tang is super accessible and ready to help students with any questions.

She is hilarious and really tries to relate to our age group. Her class doesnt have too many grades, so make sure you try for those few grades, other than that the class is really low maintenance. She is a really interesting professor and knows a lot about what she is talking about. Highly recommend.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: AMAZING PROF!! Her lectures are actually super entertaining and she keeps her students engaged. It is easy to learn the material because she presents it in a memorable way. This class isn't hard at all if you pay attention to her lectures and study the review before the tests. She genuinely cares about her students and their success. 10/10 prof!!

Super sweet and helpful prof. Class should be pretty easy, pop quizzes can be an A even without reading. Tests are a bit more difficult, just make sure you know the study guide she gives you. She's funny and a pretty good lecturer, class is usually pretty interesting.
Tests were tricky sometimes, but I was still able to study the night before and make an A. Really sweet and caring professor.
Lu tang is the sweetest!!! Thoroughly enjoyed her class, come to the lectures and you will pass. Never read the book and passed all the quizzes, easy group project! Take her!
Professor Tang is such a sweet lady. Just show up to lectures, take notes, and you're fine! Pop quizzes every now and then, but she drops the lowest quiz grade. I would take her again
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--EXTRA CREDIT--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Lu Tangs class was an easy A! Lectures were engaging. You could get an easy A without going to class but the surprise quizzes make it mandatory attendance. However, quizzes are usually at the beginning of every new chapter! Tests are all application based. 10/10 recommend
reviews.ratingTags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Lu Tang is super kind, caring, and wants to pull the best out of her students. She's young & calm but don't be fooled, she's still a tough grader. No group project, (2) tests & they are very easy if you study. It's a writing intensive course so you WILL write & conduct a research cultural audit, but she gives plenty of time & feedback to do well.

Tang is a very nice professor. She does give five pop quizzes but drops the lowest one. Aside from that, she has 3 exams none which are cumulative and a group project. Overall her exams were easy just make sure you read and are familiar with the theories. I would definitely recommend her!

Professor Tang is such a sweet lady. Show up for the lectures and take notes, study a day before the exam, and you'll pass and get an A or B. Her lectures are interesting and she obviously cares about her students
